scope: Exploratory whole-part transient thermal simulation; no selected machine or calibrated WE43 LPBF material card

material.name: WE43 conventional wrought alloy, constant bulk reference only
material.source_locator: Physical properties of magnesium wrought alloys, WE43 row

assumptions.support_model: Homogenized vertical columns below the first occupied part cell; same constant WE43 bulk properties; perfect isothermal plate contact; no supplier support topology
assumptions.source_model: Sequential macro-layer scan and cooling/recoat phases; scan energy from all 30 um slice areas; no resolved individual hatch or laser spot
assumptions.powder_surroundings: Exposed faces exchange convection and linearized radiation with the ambient; surrounding powder conduction is omitted
unknowns: WE43 LPBF k(T), cp(T), enthalpy and powder properties
actual hatch order, contours, jumps and recoating time
melt flow, phase change and evaporation
elastic-plastic material data, residual stress and support-release distortion
